name: Floating solar
principle: PV modules mounted on floats moored on reservoirs, lakes or near-shore water. The World Bank found floating PV grew from about 10 MW at end 2014 to 1.1 GW by September 2018, with a conservative global potential of 400 GW, a cooling-driven yield gain, and lifetime costs at par with land PV.

process_steps.name: Floats and mooring hold the array
Inverters and submarine or floating cables to shore

source.note: World Bank Group and SERIS, Where Sun Meets Water: floating solar market report, 30 October 2018
